summary: Approval request: timeboxed obfuscated session handoff to Privacy triage for customer incident
description:
Issue summary: Request for short-lived, obfuscated session handoff from Support to Privacy Triage to investigate a suspected customer PII exposure during a streaming session in prod.

Impact: Low-volume event affecting 2 customer sessions across us-west; customer has reported redacted snippet that may include a token-like string. No confirmed exfiltration; request is precautionary to validate redaction patterns and confirm no downstream storage.

Justification: Privacy team needs targeted session context (only first 200 tokens of each session plus metadata) to validate redaction rules and confirm whether post-processing stored any sensitive fragments. Support already attempted local redaction and sampling but requires Privacy engineers to run pattern checks and replay in a sandbox.

Access requested: Two obfuscated session snapshots (session IDs provided), each reduced to first 200 tokens, all user-provided free-text replaced with salted hash except token-like strings left for pattern analysis. No API keys, no full raw traces. Access window: 6 hours.

Duration and scope: 2026-03-14 09:00 UTC to 2026-03-14 15:00 UTC (6 hours). Data will be accessed only from Privacy VPC sandbox. No extracts allowed outside approved VPC.

Data minimization and audit controls: Only fields requested (session_id, timestamp, truncated_obfuscated_payload, model, region, route) will be provisioned. All access will be logged; KMS audit enabled; access recorded to internal audit log and linked to this ticket.

Approvals required: Security approval for obfuscation method and ephemeral KMS unwrap, Privacy lead sign-off for triage, and SRE notice for any sandbox replay.

Requester: Maya Chen (Support)

Notes: This is NOT a general log access request; it is scoped and timeboxed to reduce compliance surface area. If Privacy requests deeper slices, a new approval with legal signoff will be required.
comments: 2026-03-11 15:22 - Maya Chen: Created request after customer reported suspicious snippet. Provided session IDs and initial redaction attempt. Requested Privacy-led review for pattern confirmation.

2026-03-11 17:05 - Elena Torres (Privacy): Acknowledged. Need confirmation on obfuscation algorithm (salted SHA256) and whether the hashed values are reversible. Also request assurance that no key material is included. Pending Security review.

2026-03-12 09:30 - Ravi Kapoor (Infra): Confirmed we can provision ephemeral snapshot with enforced KMS policy and timebound IAM role. Will prepare a sandbox pod and an audit stream to the security log. Need explicit list of fields to include.

2026-03-13 11:12 - Security (Omar Ruiz): Reviewed obfuscation method. Salted SHA256 ok if salt is ephemeral and not stored. Approve conditional on ephemeral salt rotation and no write-access to persistent stores from sandbox. Security will generate the IAM role and KMSEncrypt/Decrypt policy.
2026-03-14 07:58 - Maya Chen: Updated ticket with final obfuscation spec and confirmed sessions: session-20260310-8a7f and session-20260312-3c2b. Requested provisioning window 09:00-15:00 UTC.
investigation_notes: Support reproduced redacted snippet locally; pattern looks like a 40+ char token interleaved with punctuation. Initial log crawl shows two sessions with similar structures. No evidence of persistent write to customer blob store (billing pipeline and long-term archive show no new objects at the timestamps). Network egress audit for the host shows normal traffic; no unusual external IPs. Privacy requested an obfuscated view to validate regexes against token-like fragments without exposing raw user text.
resolution_notes: Approved by Security (Omar Ruiz) and Privacy lead (Elena Torres). Infra (Ravi) provisioned ephemeral sandbox and IAM role at 2026-03-14 08:50 UTC. Snapshot exported to sandbox as truncated_obfuscated_payload and made available to Privacy triage. Access window enforced and all accesses logged. No sensitive content found by Privacy; follow-up: update regex-based redaction rule and deploy to streaming preprocessors (Follow-up task created: INT-629305). Ticket resolved after post-triage verification and audit log review.
resolution: Resolved - timeboxed obfuscated snapshots provided and privacy triage completed; recommended redaction rule update and no evidence of persistent exposure.
